title: NeuralGCM: a hybrid physics-and-learning model for weather and climate
summary: At 1.4° resolution, the model outperformed ECMWF-ENS in 95% of cases for forecasts from 2 to 15 days; at 2.8°, its mean 1980–2020 temperature error was 0.25 °C versus 0.75 °C for atmosphere-only models. It is more than 3,500 times faster than X-SHiELD on a TPU. It models only the atmosphere and is not yet a complete climate model.
ai_technology: NeuralGCM (differentiable dynamical core and neural networks)
